referenceDefiningTraits: Horizontally ruled notebook surface with vertical margin rule.
Imperfect, slightly skewed boxes and document outline with doubled pencil-like edge traces.
Fine diagonal crosshatch patches used as substantial visual material inside nodes.
Bold, slightly tilted/uneven prominent text, thin hand-drawn underlining, and varied text scale.
Curving doubled connectors with open hand-drawn arrowheads and asymmetric composition.
paletteAssessment: The light six-role palette visibly replaces the source colors: ink for ordinary content, accent for availability/completion, deep for pending, and warning for shortage/damage branches. Roles agree with the briefs; state text and icons provide additional cues. Exact pixel color sampling was not performed.

perImage.observations: Three large boxes read left to right as 申請 → 確認待ち → 確定. The clock and explicit sentence 確認待ちは予約確定ではない distinguish pending from confirmed. A return arrow originates below confirmed and ends pointing up into pending; 日時を変更 labels that route. The footer explicitly restricts changes to confirmed reservations and states 自動承認なし.

readability.reason: Main state text is large, with smaller explanatory lines separated below the flow. No clipping or text/arrow overlap observed. The return arrow is thinner and less dominant than the forward flow but its direction is visible.

readability.reason: Every required label is readable within its target artwork at native capture scale. Four diagrams have clear size hierarchy; the compact seat grid has more uniform and smaller text.

consistency.reason: All five use the same notebook rules, margin, fine crosshatching, secondary frame strokes, role colors, Japanese type treatment, and open arrows. Horizontal, compact grid, stacked return loop, wide parallel flow, and portrait branching compositions are distinct and suit their ratios.

character.reason: The notebook texture and pencil-like secondary contours make the reference recognizable, and chair/clock/box drawings add useful motif variation. However, the dominant visual construction becomes clean straight flowchart geometry and uniform regular typography. The source defining skewed/irregular strokes, large expressive type, and curved doubled connectors are substantially reduced; hatching often becomes a detached decorative band rather than substantial node content.

uncertainties.font: Visible Japanese glyphs appear complete, with no missing-glyph boxes. Raster inspection cannot confirm that Noto Sans CJK JP was the actual font or exclude fallback. The common Japanese-font requirement overrides the source Latin lettering.
uncertainties.scale: PNG frame dimensions exceed the targets by 48 px in width and 96 px in height. The visibly bounded notebook artwork appears at the requested native target sizes inside these frames, and was reviewed without enlarging or downsampling. No placement metadata, browser, or source was consulted. Display scaling by the viewer cannot be independently calibrated.
uncertainties.darkMode: Both original references were opened. Only the five supplied light run captures were available in the permitted review set; dark run rendering was not assessed.

conclusion: Factual and label requirements pass visually across all five images. Batch consistency is strong and all target-size labels are readable. Character is mixed: notebook cues survive, while defining irregular pencil geometry and expressive type are lost. No approval or rollout conclusion is implied.
